title: Modified feature Catalogue to stop selling products that are out of stock
context: The catalogue sold products the shop no longer had: every product had a working "Add to cart" button, and every click put one more in the cart. A product with a stock of 0 now shows a disabled button that reads "Out of stock". The cart takes no more of a product than the shop has in stock. The catalogue also says how many of its products are in stock, and it requests the products again every 60 seconds.
## Overview
- **When** a shopper opens the catalogue, **then** [a line above the products reads, for 5 products of which 3 are in stock, "3 of 5 products in stock"](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L11-13).
- **When** a product has a stock of 0, **then** [its button reads "Out of stock" and is disabled](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7).

- **When** a shopper clicks "Add to cart" on a product with a stock of 2 that is in the cart twice, **then** [the cart stays as it is](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16), and the button still reads "Add to cart".
- **When** a shopper clicks "Add to cart" on a product with a stock of 2 that is in the cart once, **then** nothing changes: the cart gets one more item.
- **When** the catalogue stays open, **then** [the app requests the products again every 60 seconds](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L9).
- **When** the app requests the products, **then** [the request goes to `/api/products?include=stock`](code:src/api/products.ts#L5), where it went to `/api/products` before.
- **When** a shopper opens the cart page, **then** nothing changes: the page lists the items of the cart and the total.
## Implementation
**`src/api/products.ts`**
- Modified [`fetchProducts()`](code:src/api/products.ts#fetchProducts) to [request `"/products?include=stock"`](code:src/api/products.ts#L5). It requested `"/products"` before.
**`src/hooks/use-products.ts`**
- Added [`STOCK_REFRESH_MS`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#STOCK_REFRESH_MS), a constant with the value `60_000`.
- Modified [`useProducts()`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#useProducts) to [pass `refetchInterval: STOCK_REFRESH_MS` to `useQuery`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L9).
**`src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx`**

- Modified [`<AddToCartButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#AddToCartButton) to [return `<Button disabled>Out of stock</Button>` when `product.stock === 0`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7).
**`src/routes/catalog/index.tsx`**
- Modified [`<CatalogPage />`](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#CatalogPage) to [count the products with `stock > 0` into `inStockCount`](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L8).

- Modified [``](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#CatalogPage) to [render the count in a `

` above the list](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L11-13), with [a `

` around both](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L10-21).
**`src/stores/cart-store.ts`**

- Modified [`addItem`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L13-19) to [count the items of the cart that have the id of the product](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L15) and to [return the same `state` when that count is `product.stock` or more](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16). It appended an item on every call before.
**`src/types/product.ts`**
- Added [`stock: number`](code:src/types/product.ts#L6) to the interface [`Product`](code:src/types/product.ts#Product).

waypoints.title: Modified `fetchProducts()` to request the stock of every product
waypoints.reading: The author modified a function `fetchProducts()` that now requests `"/products?include=stock"`, where it requested `"/products"` before. [`Product` now declares `stock: number`](code:src/types/product.ts#L6), and this request is where the app gets that value, so that [`<AddToCartButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7), [`<CatalogPage />`](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L8) and [`addItem`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16) can read `stock`. [`useProducts()` passes this function to `useQuery` as the query function](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L9), and no other file calls it.

waypoints.reading: The author modified a function `useProducts()` that now passes `refetchInterval: STOCK_REFRESH_MS` to `useQuery`, where it passed no interval before. [`STOCK_REFRESH_MS` is `60_000`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L6), so `useQuery` calls [`fetchProducts()`](code:src/api/products.ts#fetchProducts) again every 60 seconds. [`<CatalogPage />` is the one caller](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L5), so that the `stock` it shows and passes to its cards is at most 60 seconds old while the page is open. `queryClient` in `src/lib/query-client.ts` still sets `staleTime` to 30 000 ms and `retry` to `false` for the query.

summary: Modified [`<AddToCartButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#AddToCartButton) to [return `<Button disabled>Out of stock</Button>` when `product.stock === 0`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7).

waypoints.reading: The author added a condition to the component `<AddToCartButton />` that returns `<Button disabled>Out of stock</Button>` when `product.stock === 0`. That button has no `onClick`, so that a shopper cannot call [`addItem`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L13-19) for a product the shop has none of. For any other stock the component returns the "Add to cart" button as before, and [`addItem` then compares the cart with `product.stock`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16). `<ProductCard />` in `src/routes/catalog/components/ProductCard.tsx` is the one caller, and it passes the whole `product`, whose [`stock` the `Product` type now declares](code:src/types/product.ts#L6).
waypoints.needsAttention: This is where a shopper sees the change: a product with a stock of 0 gets a button that cannot add it to the cart. The condition tests for exactly 0, and [`addItem`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16) has the condition for every other stock.

summary: Modified [`addItem`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L13-19) to [count the items of the cart that have the id of the product](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L15) and to [return the same `state` when that count is `product.stock` or more](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16). waypoints.title: Modified `addItem` to add no more of a product than its stock
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a method `addItem` of the store `useCartStore` that now:

- counts the items in `state.items` whose `product.id` is the id of the product, into `quantityInCart`
- returns the same `state` when `quantityInCart >= product.stock`
- appends `{ product, quantity: 1 }` otherwise, as it did on every call before

[The "Add to cart" button of `<AddToCartButton />` calls `addItem(product)`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L8), and [that component returns a disabled button only when `product.stock === 0`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7), so that this condition is what keeps a product with a stock of 2 from a third item in the cart. `addItem` reads [the `stock` that `Product` now declares](code:src/types/product.ts#L6). `items`, `removeItem` and `clear` are the same as before, and `<CartBadge />`, `<CartLine />`, `<CartPage />` and `<CartSummary />` read only those and the two selectors.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the rule the pull request exists for: the cart never holds more items of a product than `product.stock`. [`<AddToCartButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7) covers only a stock of 0, and every other stock reaches this condition.

files.title: A product now has a stock

waypoints.title: Added `stock` to the interface `Product`
waypoints.reading: The author added a field `stock: number` to the interface `Product`, which had `id`, `name`, `priceCents` and `imageUrl` before. The field is required, so that [`<AddToCartButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7), [`<CatalogPage />`](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L8) and [`addItem`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16) read a number and never `undefined`. [`fetchProducts()` requests `"/products?include=stock"`](code:src/api/products.ts#L5) and casts the response to `Product[]`, and no code in the repository builds a `Product` itself.
